SecurityAndAnalysisStatus.title: GitHub Advanced Security
SecurityAndAnalysisStatus.description: (GHAS-licensed) Master toggle for GitHub Advanced Security features. Free on public repos; requires a GHAS license on private repos.

SecurityAndAnalysisStatus_2.title: Secret scanning
SecurityAndAnalysisStatus_2.description: Detect exposed credentials and sensitive data committed to the repository.

SecurityAndAnalysisStatus_3.title: Secret scanning push protection
SecurityAndAnalysisStatus_3.description: Block git pushes that contain detected secrets.

SecurityAndAnalysisStatus_4.title: Secret scanning AI detection
SecurityAndAnalysisStatus_4.description: (GHAS-licensed) AI-powered detection of generic secrets beyond standard provider patterns.

SecurityAndAnalysisStatus_5.title: Secret scanning non-provider patterns
SecurityAndAnalysisStatus_5.description: (GHAS-licensed) Detect custom secret patterns beyond the standard provider list.

SecurityAndAnalysisStatus_6.title: Delegated alert dismissal
SecurityAndAnalysisStatus_6.description: (org-only) Allow delegated dismissal of secret scanning alerts.

SecurityAndAnalysisStatus_7.title: Delegated push protection bypass
SecurityAndAnalysisStatus_7.description: (org-only) Allow delegated approval of secret scanning push protection bypass requests.

DelegatedBypassReviewerMode.title: Delegated bypass reviewer mode
DelegatedBypassReviewerMode.description: ALWAYS: reviewer is always required to approve bypass; EXEMPT: reviewer can bypass without review

team.title: Team slug
team.description: GitHub team slug (e.g., "security-team"); resolved to numeric reviewer_id at sync time

role.title: Organization role name
role.description: Organization role name as defined in `GET /orgs/{org}/organization-roles` (e.g., "all_repo_admin", "security_manager"). Resolved to the numeric role ID at sync time.

DelegatedBypassReviewer.title: Delegated bypass reviewer
DelegatedBypassReviewer.description: A reviewer who can approve secret-scanning push-protection bypass requests. Must specify exactly one of team or role.

SecurityAndAnalysisStatus_8.title: Dependabot security updates
SecurityAndAnalysisStatus_8.description: Automatically open pull requests to patch known dependency vulnerabilities.

anyOf.title: Delegated bypass reviewers
anyOf.description: (org-only) Reviewers authorized to approve push protection bypass requests. Each entry must specify a team slug or role name.

SecurityAndAnalysis.title: Security and analysis
SecurityAndAnalysis.description: GitHub repository security_and_analysis fields applied via the same PATCH /repos call as other settings. (GHAS-licensed) fields require a GHAS license on private repos; (org-only) fields are silently skipped on personal repos.
